html: נלה doubtful √ (Arabic نيل, نَالَ is obtain, attain, نَيْلٌ what one obtains by another’s bounty, Lane3040);—for supposed Hiph. Inf. sf. כַּנְּלֹתְךָ Is 33:1 = כְּהַנְלֹתְךָ (Ki GesLgb. 87 Köi. 574), read כְּכַלֹּתְךָ (Pi. Inf. of כלה; so Ra Capp GesThes Ew Kn Che Brd Di Du), cf. ‖ כַּהֲתִֽמְךָ.
